name: Ysolde Rime
seed: To publish the actual Severance record, including her order’s necessary and self-serving choices.
design: Arctic hare, ivory fur, long dark-tipped ears, glacier-blue coat, copper scarf pin.
history: An archive interpreter trained to separate echo-ice sound from later stories attached to it.
desire: To publish the actual Severance record, including her order’s necessary and self-serving choices.
contradiction: Facts become armor against grief; she neglects how a revelation lands on people.
relationships: Ossa taught her; Oren wants technical evidence; Bot recognizes her discomfort with uncertainty.
arc: Challenges the forged prohibition while preserving a real dangerous closure. Truth becomes a shared burden rather than a triumphant exposure.
story_engine: An old voice repeats a sentence in the wrong order; an apparently heroic ancestor made a consequential mistake.
writer_truth: Her own family benefited from prolonged closure, and she publishes that fact too.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
